home-start: Tap the big orange button. Listen to each page first, then read it out loud yourself.
home-full: Your reading bar is full for today. Brilliant! You can read some more, or come back tomorrow.
step-listen: First, press Listen, and follow the words as you hear them.
step-turn: Now it's your turn. Press Read aloud, read the page out loud, then press I've finished.
best: Read this page all by yourself, like a storyteller. Smooth, like talking. Pause at full stops and commas. Make your voice match the meaning.
words: Press Say it, then read the word out loud. Press Hear it if you want to hear it first.
retry-none: I couldn't hear any reading. Check the microphone, then try again.
retry-part: I only heard part of the page. Read all of it out loud, a little louder, then try again.
retry-fast: That was too quick to be reading aloud. Read it at your normal speed.
retry-gaps: There were long gaps in the reading. Try the page again, nice and steady.
library: Choose a book to read. Tap a cover to start.
done-keep: Well done! Keep reading to fill today's bar.
timed: Read the passage out loud for one minute. Read carefully and steadily. If you get stuck on a word, have a go and carry on.
